profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack & Data Engineering | Databricks, Azure, Python
profile.summary:
Software engineer specializing in data engineering, cloud based ETL pipelines, and large scale data processing. Experienced in designing and implementing scalable data solutions using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and PySpark. Skilled in ETL development and cloud orchestration, improving data reliability and accessibility.

Before transitioning into data engineering, worked as a controls and automation engineer, developing applications for factory automation and industrial data systems. Strong background in problem-solving, troubleshooting, and optimizing system performance in complex environments.

In my free time, you’ll find me practicing yoga, muay thai, traveling, researching topics that spark my curiosity, meditating, or attempting to convince my wife that I’m not a Type 5 according to the Enneagram.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, and PySpark-based ETL applications in Python, ensuring efficient data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration across systems.
- Identified and resolved critical issues in cloud-based data pipelines, including fixing system bugs, optimizing database queries, and addressing schema inconsistencies.
positions.insights: Skills: PySpark · Python (Programming Language) · PL/SQL · Microsoft Azure · Azure Data Lake · Computer Science · Unit Testing · Databricks · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained a job portal using Express.js, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL to help users find jobs that assist in reducing student debt.   
- Integrated third-party services, including MailChimp for email automation, Google Geocoding for location services, and third-party web scrapers for job data aggregation.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · React.js · Heroku · JavaScript · Node.js · Computer Science · Redis · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Netlify · MailChimp

positions.title: Controls Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the specification, implementation, and documentation of Traction converter software used in customer applications according to design guidelines and best practices.

Developed CODESYS-based applications complying with the project-specific  requirements.

Fine-tuned the software during vehicle commissioning and troubleshoot technical issues.

positions.title: Product Manager and Sales Engineer
positions.description:
- Managed SCADA software sales and exceeded sales KPIs by **120% in the first 6 months**.  
- Led SCADA product marketing, implementation, and scaling strategies in South Korea.  
- Delivered product training workshops to **200+ attendees**, improving customer engagement.

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed SCADA applications and PLC programs, while providing technical training to engineering firms and customers through **20+ workshops** on system implementation and best practices.  
- Designed and implemented **Visual Basic background services** when needed to automate data exchange between SCADA systems and other applications, enabling real time monitoring and control.
